# compute_psd_uniform_rust { #mofography.rust_fun.compute_psd_uniform_rust }

```python
rust_fun.compute_psd_uniform_rust(
    dgrid,
    ase_atoms,
    num_samples_total=10000,
    bins=None,
    density=False,
    return_fig=False,
    material='Material',
)
```

Compute pore size distribution using uniform sampling.

This function calculates the pore size distribution by sampling points uniformly
throughout the material and optionally creates a plotly figure for visualization.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name                    | Type                  | Description                                                    | Default      |
|-------------------------|-----------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------|--------------|
| dgrid                   | numpy.ndarray         | 3D distance grid from dgrid_from_atoms_rust                    | _required_   |
| ase_atoms               | ase.Atoms             | ASE Atoms object of the material                               | _required_   |
| num_samples_total       | int                   | Total number of sample points to generate                      | `10000`      |
| bins                    | numpy.ndarray \| None | Bin edges for histogram. If None, uses np.linspace(0, 50, 200) | `None`       |
| density                 | bool                  | Whether to normalize the histogram                             | `False`      |
| return_fig              | bool                  | Whether to return a plotly figure along with the histogram     | `False`      |
| material                | str                   | Name of the material for plot title                            | `'Material'` |
| probe_center_min_radius | float \| None         | If > 0, only void voxels with dgrid >= this value are sampled. | _required_   |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                                                 | Description                                                                            |
|--------|----------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | numpy.ndarray \| tuple\[numpy.ndarray, plotly.graph_objects.Figure\] | If return_fig is False, returns histogram values. If True, returns (histogram, figure) |
